input.quote: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products
input.rationale: Section 6.1 imposes exclusive dealing on us (the Company): we may not participate in any similar Internet project for Deerskin Products or substantially similar products for the whole term, and Section 4.1 makes that term one year automatically renewing on each anniversary, so the restriction can run indefinitely. There is no automatic exit if HDI fails to perform (Section 1.6 only gives a one-off termination right if the Site is not live within 70 days). That is walk-away territory (exclusive dealing for the full term with no performance-based exit) and fails the fallback on duration and on performance-based termination. HDI's own non-compete in Section 6.3 and HDI's brand exclusivity are not flagged, as restrictions on the counterparty benefit us. The scope element is already satisfied by the existing "Deerskin Products" product category, so the redline only fixes duration and adds the automatic performance exit.

proposal.summary: Limit the Company's exclusivity in Section 6.1 to 12 months and end it automatically on HDI performance failures.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 6.1 binds us for the entire (automatically renewing) term with no performance-based exit, which is outside our position. We have limited the restriction to twelve months from the Effective Date and made it end automatically if HDI misses a service level or delivery date; the existing Deerskin Products scope is unchanged.

ops.oldText: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products
ops.newText: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, for twelve (12) months from the Effective Date, ending automatically upon HDI's failure to meet any service level or delivery date, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products
